title: An Orangist correspondent at Basle to William V, 17 Aug 1796 (KHA Prins Willem V inv. 339; DECODE R2234)

documents.shelfmark: Koninklijk Huisarchief, The Hague, Prins Willem V, inv. 339; DECODE R2234
documents.route: an Orangist correspondent at Basle -> William V

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the DECODE image or record.

transcription.source: DECODE IMG_R2234_I15510_P1, rotated, cut into bands
transcription.notes: distinct 30 counts j and stray case/punctuation letters in the file; cipher alphabet is 25 letters.

system.summary: Five monoalphabetic alphabets D, G, L, N, R from a printed key sheet (R2235), cycled one per line from the section's opening capital.
system.sibling_key: DECODE R2235 key sheet in the same inventory number; used directly.
system.notes: D/R and G/N are mutual inverses, L is self-inverse. DECODE catalogues it as homophonic; it is not.

prior_solution.where: DECODE status non-decrypted; record note points to the key R2235 but gives no reading

conditions.human_role: Project-level: DECODE login cookie supplied, problem posed with /goal. No target-specific intervention.

solution.what: Fetched R2234 scan and key records R2235 (two sheets) and R2240 with the session cookie.
Transcribed the R2235 Schrijf Tafel: five alphabets D,G,L,N,R; D/R and G/N inverse pairs, L self-inverse.
Transcribed the letter (1321 cipher letters) from rotated crops.
Whole section D under alphabet D: line 1 reads ('depuis le 12 juillet'), line 2 does not.
All five alphabets on lines 2-5: G, L, N, R read in turn; one alphabet per line, cycling from the section capital.
Whole letter decrypted and corrected for transcription slips into reading.txt.

outcome.method_basis: The key sheet R2235 (five alphabets) is filed in the same KHA inventory number and the DECODE record note points to it; the project found the one-alphabet-per-line cycling rule and decrypted the whole letter.
outcome.notes: Every cipher letter has a value; a few words stay unresolved because of transcription slips, signature not read.
